THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: POL/MDG/LND/01/97/Kantale Road/General. Land Ministry’s Ref. No .: 4/3/10/2018/MV/248 & 27.10.2021. I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire following lands for the expansion of the road from Medirigiriya to Kantale 85 junction under the Moragahakanda Development Project.
